BUYER BEWARE

Don't buy from Aliexpress unless you're sure you'll keep the product. THEY DON'T GIVE ACTUAL RETURNS. They say they do, but you can only get partial returns (maybe 30% back of original price). You only have 14-15 days return window. And it's not possible to return just because you don't want the item - it has to be damaged or something. That being said, you can still find excellent products there - just don't expect returns as an option.

data.review_body:
After months of back and forth emails in which Aliexpress claimed to have delivered some furniture to us and we stated, emphatically, that it didn't, I just received this email from Aliexpress:

Dear Customer,

Regarding your order #3074703395752487, we sincerely apologize for the unpleasant experience you’ve had and for not receiving your package as expected.

According to the logistics tracking information, the status of your parcel is marked as "Delivered." However, we fully understand and take seriously your feedback that you did not actually receive the package. We recognize how concerning and frustrating this situation can be, and we truly appreciate your patience.

Please note that once a package arrives in the destination country, the final delivery is handled by the local postal service or courier provider. In accordance with our dispute resolution policy, we kindly recommend contacting your local post office or delivery company directly to further verify the actual delivery details—for example, whether it was delivered to a neighbor, placed in a mailbox, or left at a pickup point due to missed delivery attempts.

If it is confirmed that the package was indeed not delivered or has been lost, we kindly ask you to request an official **"Undelivered Proof"** or **"Lost Parcel Certificate"** from the relevant authority. The document should include the following:

- The tracking number of the parcel  
- A clear statement confirming the failure of delivery or loss of the package  
- An official stamp, agency logo, or electronic signature as valid authentication  
- If provided via email, please include a full screenshot showing the sender’s email address, subject line, and message body  

Once we receive a valid proof that meets these requirements, we will immediately submit it for review and proceed with the appropriate resolution, such as a refund or compensation, as quickly as possible.

For your convenience, below are the recommended contact details for the local logistics provider:  Chronopost.

Thank you sincerely for your understanding and cooperation throughout this process. Should you have any questions or updates, please don’t hesitate to reply to this email—we are always here to support you.

Wishing you all the best and smooth days ahead!

Best regards,  
AliExpress Customer Service Team  

Here's my reply:

NO! I will not waste another second on your red tape.

We attempted to confirm delivery status with both the original and local delivery service using our order number for tracking purposes.

Both indicated that they have no record of our shipment/order/purchase in their records or systems.

That's it! Aliexpress messed up and we now expect Aliexpress to fix this by refunding, in full, our payment.

If not, we will continue to post your emails (as this one) and our responses on consumer review-satisfaction websites ... like Trustpilot.

In fact, we just did!
data.review_headline: Once, shame on you. Twice, shame on me.

VERY DISAPPOINTING RETURN POLICY.

AliExpress says that they offer free returns, but when you actually want to return something , they do not make it easy and do not allow you to return the item as advertised. This is very misleading and disappointing. I would not recommend buying from a company that does not honour its own return policy.

NEVER NEVER EVER AGAIN!!!
Okay what they sell is obviously mostly trash. I bought some items, which were much different from their pictures, so I requested to return. BUT they said I have to pay 3 euros PER ITEM to return it and everything must be sent separately using their assigned QR codes. No, obviously I won't pay that money. I wrote a lot with their AI bots and said that they actually promise free return but asking 3 euros is unfair but I just received AI messages... I requested again but they said I CANNOT return an item because the reason I gave was not good enough (I chose I want to return because the quality is not as expected). But according to German laws, I have a 14-day window to return an item without explanation. They are obviously breaking the law by not allowing the customers to return. They should just be banned.

data.review_body:
I purchased the 4 pack of 6Ah Makita batteries for $110
They arrived in about three weeks and looked, in every way, to be genuine, However, they seemed to weigh less than some genuine batteries I already owned.
On further investigation they weighed about 20% less than the genuine product and do not hold a charge.
I complained to AliExpress and they agreed to refund half my purchase price AND send me 4 genuine replacements. They refunded just 1 cent and did not send any replacements, despite telling me they were in the post and to be patient. 7 weeks later they are now saying I am not  getting my refund and that the supplier is no longer trading, despite the products still be widely available on their website.
DON'T deal with these guys as the products are NOT genuine.  Yes, I was a fool for believing that they would be for that price.
data.review_headline: Makita batteries are NOT genuine. Check the weight.
